scope: Saved assembled fitted timbers only; no source-prism or exploded-pose collision claims.
method: Fresh convex-cell pair intersections, using prototype numerical half-space kernel. AABB tests only prune candidates.
limitations: A lack of material intersections does not authenticate the fitted joint design.
The generated partition deliberately assigns overlapping source-stock regions to different timber owners.
This does not approve bearing, retained wood, tenon size, shrinkage allowance, tool access, or insertion paths.
